title: ProvSoftwareAgent
description: Rootless shape facet — PROV SoftwareAgent type: "a software agent is running software." One of the three agent types PROV defines for interoperability. PROV defines no attributes specific to SoftwareAgent. Source: W3C PROV-DM (REC-prov-dm-20130430) §5.3.1 Agent, prov:SoftwareAgent; PROV-O prov:SoftwareAgent.

id.description: Identifier for the software agent — mandatory per PROV-DM §5.7.1; a qualified name, mappable to an IRI (§5.7.5).
